chunks: From the same Sermon: [In it, he divides people into three categories:]

He who has heaven and hell in his view has no other aim. He who attempts and acts quickly, succeeds, while the seeker who is slow may also entertain hope, and he who falls short of action faces destruction in Hell.

On right and left there are misleading paths. Only the middle way is the (right) path which is the Everlasting Book and the traditions of the Prophet. From it the sunnah has spread out and towards it is the eventual return.
ai.seo_question: What are the three categories of people according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) categorizes humanity into three types based on their spiritual focus and action: the successful who keep the afterlife in view and act swiftly, the hopeful who are slow but persistent, and the negligent who fall into Hell. He identifies the 'middle way' as the true path, grounded in the Quran and the Prophet's Sunnah, which leads to ultimate success. This classification reflects the Shia emphasis on balanced action (amal) and adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's interpretation of the 'middle path' (al-sirat al-mustaqim) as the safeguard against the extremes of negligence and hasty presumption.
